name: live_message_box_consent
description: The host's script shows NVDLC04TempleNukeAllConfirmMSG, the Lonesome Road launch box that the NVDLC04MQ03b consent row lists. The host player presses Yes (button 1). A script line asks GetButtonPressed once a second, as the terminal's GameMode block does. The host's press opens a consent vote: the guest gets the vote prompt and votes yes at 12 s. Until the guest's vote reaches the host, GetButtonPressed gives -1 (held). After the vote the script gets button 1 and sets CG03TestValue to 3, which reaches both peers.

if GetButtonPressed == 1
set CG03TestValue to 3
